summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Zendesk Settings Panel UI in Connected Accounts page. All 7 features tested and working correctly. The Zendesk settings panel matches the detailed, guided UI design with Connection card, Integration Status card, Response Mode toggles, and Save Settings button. New account setup shows two-column layout with form and 5-step guide.
critical_code_review_comments: All UI elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Toggle states update visually with smooth transitions
Save Settings correctly calls PUT /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/accounts/{account_id} with metadata
Test button correctly calls POST /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/accounts/{account_id}/test and shows appropriate error for expired token
Auth method switch (OAuth 2.0 / API Token) correctly shows/hides relevant form fields
Two-column layout for new account setup with 5-step guide is well implemented
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing Zendesk account 016e6207-68d7-4034-b321-fd2ce2ae1e50
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zendesk Settings Panel in Connected Accounts page fully tested. Key test IDs: zendesk-setup-panel, zendesk-status-badge, zendesk-connection-card, zendesk-test-btn, zendesk-status-card, zendesk-active-badge, zendesk-mode-card, zendesk-toggle-auto-reply, zendesk-toggle-agent-assist, zendesk-save-settings-btn, zendesk-reconnect-btn, zendesk-disconnect-btn. New account setup fields: zendesk-account-name, zendesk-subdomain-input, zendesk-oauth-client-id, zendesk-oauth-client-secret, zendesk-redirect-uri, zendesk-user-email, zendesk-api-token. Test button returns 401 for expired token (expected with test credentials).

features_tested.feature: Zendesk Settings Panel - Connected Account View
features_tested.details: Header with Zendesk icon + ACTIVE badge, Connection card with subdomain (midnight-gd.zendesk.com) and OAuth info, Test button, Scopes bar, Reconnect/Disconnect buttons, Integration Status card with Active badge, Response Mode toggles (Auto-Reply off, Agent Assist on), Save Settings button - all present and functional

Auto-Reply toggle changes from rgba(148,163,184,0.2) to rgb(23,165,137) when clicked. Agent Assist toggle changes from rgb(96,165,250) to rgba(148,163,184,0.2) when clicked. Visual state changes work correctly.
Clicking Save Settings calls PUT /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/accounts/{account_id} and shows 'Settings saved' toast
Clicking Test button calls POST /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/accounts/{account_id}/test. Returns 401 error for expired token (expected with test credentials). Error message displayed in toast.
Clicking X close button returns to accounts list correctly

features_tested.feature: New Zendesk Account Setup - Two Column Layout
features_tested.details: Left side: Account Name, Subdomain input with .zendesk.com suffix, Auth Method selector (OAuth 2.0/API Token), OAuth fields (Client ID, Client Secret, Redirect URL). Right side: 5-step setup guide with Open Zendesk Admin Center Guide link
Selecting API Token shows Admin Email and API Token fields, hides OAuth Client ID/Secret fields. Selecting OAuth 2.0 shows OAuth fields, hides API Token fields.
Shows confirmation dialog 'This account has 1 active connection(s). Disconnecting will disable them. Continue?' - Cancel returns to settings panel
Clicking Reconnect shows 'Account reconnected' toast (account was already connected)

features_tested.feature: Cancel Button on New Account Form
features_tested.details: Clicking Cancel returns to accounts list correctly

notes: Test button returns 401 'invalid_token' error because the Zendesk OAuth token is expired/revoked. This is expected behavior with test credentials - the UI correctly displays the error message from the Zendesk API.
